Milestone 6 is graded on whether the number of specifications is on the first page, and the count you did last night is the input, so today is where it becomes a corrected verdict.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- State the total number of specifications tried across the phase and the threshold it implies.
- Report the combined book's performance against that threshold rather than against zero.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>65 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Audit the log across the whole phase and classify the entries: distinct signals, variants within a signal, transform choices, combination schemes, and evaluation horizons. Then estimate the effective number of independent trials, which is smaller than the raw count because the variants are correlated, using the same reasoning as day 51.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Apply the correction to the set: compute the threshold from qlib/noise.py at your effective trial count, and report the combined book's information ratio against it with an interval. Then do the same for each individual signal. Write the verdict paragraph, which should read the same regardless of which way it came out.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [10 min]{.task-min} Note the trials that are not in the log: the ones you ran interactively and abandoned, estimated as on day 62. Say whether the gap has narrowed since then.
:::
:::
